dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engravings
dialogues.text: "...By order of Dominus Boethius, exalted Harmost, and in accord with the most sacred, beneficent Symphony of our great Sebastos, the Initium Iani are to be shut from today on. No one enters, and no one leaves..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engravings
dialogues.text: "...For the Empire, for our God King, for human civilization..."
